verdict.rationale: Twilio Video documents server-side session creation through the Rooms REST API, which sets name, type, and max participants. It also ships official native SDKs for Web, iOS, and Android and offers quickstart guides for building a basic video app. However, the evidence never shows how to mint a scoped join or access token, or how a client connects with one, so the full flow is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented scoped join-token minting, an end-to-end server-to-client connect walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration of the flow's brevity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a session from my server, mint a scoped join token, and connect a client with the official SDK in a short documented flow

citations.quote: Use this API to set Room properties such as its name, type, TURN configuration, webhook status callback URL, and the maximum number of Participants.
Twilio Video offers native SDKs for JavaScript (Web), iOS (Swift/Objective-C), and Android (Java/Kotlin).
Build a basic video app with our quickstart guides, and then customize it to fit your needs.
